name: Isodecyl isononanoate
description: Isodecyl isononanoate (CAS 59231-35-5 ) is a branched-chain ester used across personal care, industrial lubricant, and polymer formulation markets. Its low viscosity and excellent solvency make it a practical carrier. This versatile chemical serves as a plasticizing agent in both cosmetic and technical applications. In personal care formulations, it functions as an emollient carrier and solvent for actives, pigments, and UV filters. It is frequently utilized in skin creams, sunscreens, and color cosmetics. Lubricant and metalworking formulators use it as a base fluid or co-fluid where a low-odor, non-mineral ester is preferred for cleaner operations. In coatings and adhesive systems, it acts as a plasticizer and coalescing solvent, improving film flexibility and substrate adhesion. This helps ensure the longevity and durability of the final product. Polymer compounders incorporate it as a softener in elastomers and sealants where compatibility with non-polar matrices is a requirement. It provides essential flexibility to various industrial materials. The product is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid. It is available in technical and cosmetic grades, with cosmetic-grade material meeting purity standards suitable for personal care manufacturing. Packaging typically ranges from drums to IBC totes for industrial volumes.
